newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble o/n credit rates rise before T-bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Rouble o/n credit rates rise before T-bill auction.

text.p: The rouble was steady against the dollar on Tuesday but dealers said overnight rouble credit rates rose ahead of Wednesday's government bond auction.
On December 18 the central bank is auctioning eight trillion roubles of six-month T-bills and two trillion roubles of OFZ bonds.
roubles/dollar Dec 17 midday Dec 17 early Dec 16 close

"Roubles are more expensive today and the auctions seem the main factor. Overnight credit rates could firm more as trading for today settlement is already over," Inkombank dealer Vladislav Savelyev said.

Moscow Business World Bank dealer Nikolai Zolotaryov said both local and non-resident banks were seen selling dollars to participate in the auctions. He added banks were closing long rouble positions, buying dollars back for tomorrow settlement.
